messages:
marie: bringing kythera9b (9b) int4 onto dedicated — quick smoke shows generation drift vs fp16 on long contexts, not just a token here/there.
sandeep: logs?
marie: gist incoming but tl;dr: outputs start matching for the first ~100 tokens then diverge; eval ppl +12% and some repeated phrases. also weird spacing around punctuation.
jordan: did we lose any rotary/headwise flags in conversion? kythera uses headwise rotary scaling by default, converters sometimes only set a global scale.
marie: converter call used: `convert.py --in=kythera_fp16.safetensors --out=kythera_int4.safetensors --quant=awq4 --rotary=autodetect` — i think autodetect fell back to generic rotary. running kv-cache/tokenmap smoke now.
alex: also check tokenizer mapping. kythera moved a few sentinel/rare tokens to high indices recently (50265 range). if token ids shifted during conversion our kv-cache offsets could be off by a small constant.
marie: repro command i used: ```python tests/harness.py --model kythera_int4 --prompt-file tests/long_prompts.txt --max-tokens 2048 --seed 42``` — attach sample diffs.
ben: can you drop a minimal bisect harness? i can run AWQ/GPTQ variants across quant params.
marie: uploaded a tiny harness at /repos/model-tools/kythera/harness.py — includes expected token list + a headwise rotary toggle for quick toggles.
sandeep: ran the harness with rotary_head_scale=True -> matches fp16 up to ~1024 tokens. with rotary_head_scale=False diverges almost immediately (~128 tokens). converter definitely lost headwise metadata.
jordan: we should persist rotary metadata in the converted model config. PR idea: add explicit fields in model.json like `rotary_mode` and `rotary_head_scale` so runtimes pick correct behavior.
marie: also noticed tokenization normalization differences: `tokenizer.encode('–')` returns different ids between fp16 and our converted int4. suspect NFC vs NFKC normalization inconsistency.
alex: yep — some upstream exports don't write tokenizer normalization flags. converters occasionally default to NFKC which will change codepoints and token ids.
marie: next steps i'm proposing: 1) add unit tests that assert headwise rotary params survive conversion; 2) persist tokenizer normalization in tokenizer.json and tests to assert encode/decode parity; 3) rerun quant experiments (awq,gptq) with/without headscale and compare ppl + exact-match on our eval bundle.
ben: :thumbsup: i'll take the quant matrix runs on dedicated infra. spinning AWQ and GPTQ across the usual param grid, with headscale toggled.
ci-bot: job/kythera-int4-awq started on redwood-dedicated-3 (id: kj-9912)
sandeep: if headscale is required for parity, the converter should emit an explicit compatibility warning and recommend fp16 fallback instead of silently producing a divergent int4 artifact.
jordan: agreed — add a compatibility_report artifact during conversion that lists rotary/tokenizer mismatches and recommended fallbacks. set log-level=warn for missing metadata.
marie: i'll prepare the converter PR and add the minimal evaluation suite. aiming for a draft by EOD tomorrow.
ben: ping me when the PR lands and i'll wire the matrix into CI so we block releases until we preserve headscale behavior.
marie: quick diff i'll include in PR: ```+ "rotary_mode": "headwise",
+ "rotary_head_scale": "1.27"``` — that'll be written into model.json during convert.
alex: :pray:
